visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A hand holds a smartphone showing a social media video of red wine pouring over ice cream in a glass. The background is a wooden table surface. (2) A man in a black NY baseball cap and a yellow-and-blue t-shirt stands indoors, looking at the phone screen. (3) Close-up of a metal ice cream scoop extracting a portion of yellow ice cream and placing it into a clear wine glass. (4) Dark red wine flows from a bottle neck into the wine glass containing the ice cream scoops, causing the liquid to foam slightly. (5) The man in the cap uses a spoon to stir the mixture, which has a curdled, pinkish appearance. He tastes a spoonful while looking directly at the camera. (6) A man with glasses in a black shirt tastes the mixture, with a white digital smoke effect partially obscuring his face. (7) A man in a light yellow t-shirt holds the wine glass in a room with blue cabinets, tasting the dessert and speaking to the person behind the camera. (8) A woman with long dark hair, wearing a white polka-dot dress, tastes the mixture from the glass and smiles while nodding. (9) The man in the cap returns, pointing his spoon at the glass as he continues his evaluation.
